title: Port 7781 Runtime Failure - Diagnosis (stale Drive copy on 7777)
findings: Canonical runtime port is 7781 (core/runtime_config.py DEFAULT_RUNTIME_PORT=7781). 7777 is a legacy/stale port, not the governed runtime.
The process answering on 7777 is a STALE Google Drive mirror copy: 'python.exe "G:\My Drive\HawkesNest LLC\ORACLE.AI\oracle_server.py" --port 7777' (PID observed 37000).
7781 is empty because nothing launches THIS repo (C:\Oracle\ORACLE.AI-runtime) on 7781; the only ORACLE server running is the G: copy forced onto 7777.

The historical 7781 crash in Logs/oracle_startup.log ('ValueError: Unable to configure formatter default', at G: copy line 1541) is the uvicorn-under-pythonw failure: pythonw.exe gives None std streams and uvicorn's color formatter probes isatty().
This repo's oracle_server.py ALREADY fixes that at lines 43-61 (reroutes None stdout/stderr to Logs/oracle_runtime.log before uvicorn runs). The stale G: copy predates that fix.
Conclusion: not a code bug in this repo. Operational: wrong/stale copy running on the wrong port.
root_cause: Running the stale Google Drive mirror (G:\My Drive\...\ORACLE.AI) on 7777 instead of launching the patched canonical repo (C:\Oracle\ORACLE.AI-runtime) on 7781.
changes_made: Added core/healthcheck.py - probes 7781 (canonical), 11434 (Ollama), 7777 (legacy/stale) reading the port from runtime_config single-source-of-truth; exits non-zero if 7781 is down.
No change to oracle_server.py (its headless fix at lines 43-61 already resolves the formatter crash).
operator_actions_required: Stop the stale G: copy on 7777 (it is NOT the governed runtime). Identify: netstat -ano | findstr :7777 -> Stop-Process -Id <pid>.
Launch the canonical runtime from C:\Oracle\ORACLE.AI-runtime via oracle_desktop.bat (binds 7781), or: python oracle_server.py --port 7781.
Re-run: python core/healthcheck.py -> expect runtime 7781 UP.
NOTE: Claude did not stop processes or start the elevated server (hands-off gate; web server runs elevated; restart is Noah.Physical's action).
holes: G: Drive copy was not diffed against this repo; degree of divergence unknown beyond the port and the pre-fix line count.
Did not confirm whether any startup launcher still points at the G: path; oracle_desktop.bat in THIS repo correctly targets C:\Oracle\ORACLE.AI-runtime and 7781.
required_review: Noah.Physical restart canonical runtime and confirm 7781 UP
